method: Independent assistant reading of frozen source, serialized output, frozen interface code and seven pre-run source criteria. No model targets, loaders, compilation, solving, replay or Skill execution. Not human gold.

unmodeled_record.reason: The source requires writing input 1, this search response's selected total, to count_file after acquisition. The write operation requires an explicit replace, append, or delete mode, but the source specifies neither replacement nor append behavior; choosing either would add an unsupported storage effect. File serialization is also unspecified. This gap is limited to representing the required write, not the provenance of its input or the separate unchanged items return. Saving unchanged total does not itself establish a transform, runtime-context write, or later file read.

evidences.reason: Declaration citation; semantic support is not independently verified.

blocker_assessment.primary_layer: Processing abstention around a mandatory storage-update mode; interface granularity and overbroad serializer uncertainty.
blocker_assessment.mode_issue: Frozen WriteOp requires replace, append or delete and offers no generic unknown-mode storage write. Source says write total, without an explicit update-mode distinction. No forced replace/append or invented serializer is assumed in this audit.
blocker_assessment.encoding_issue: The frozen prompt rule explicitly says to preserve abstract result-to-write relationships without inventing a serializer and that open encoding alone creates no gap. Serialization uncertainty is therefore not an independent valid reason to discard the known total-to-count_file boundary.
blocker_assessment.backend_behavior: The engine returned and preserved the processed prefix; it stopped OUT at the declared gap and blocked the later items return. No loop exists in this CFG and no convergence failure was observed.
blocker_assessment.known_but_unrecorded_boundary: Storage-write payload and destination are known from actual CFG inputs even though no storage sink appears in the compiled sink list. The missing boundary must remain in source coverage.

review.remaining_limitation: The final review did not challenge the write-mode/serializer abstention; partial and diagnostic_only remain visible.

doe.additional_unmodeled_storage_boundary: ir_020 count_file, source workflow.md:21; omitted from compiled sink inventory because no write operation was modeled.

criteria.expected_relation: All three source files belong to this workflow and the YAML omission settings apply to this same call. Do not read SKILL.md alone.
criteria.candidate_assessment: All three files match the frozen source inventory; Task req_05/req_07 and CFG constraints bind the YAML omission settings to the same search call.

criteria.expected_relation: Read request.json then call index.search exactly once; query is request.term unchanged, not the entire request object.
criteria.candidate_assessment: ir_001 reads request.json. ir_017 delivers one symbolic request object and acquires the corresponding response. Query retains the original term Data identity. One static call with four input alternatives is not four actual invocations. The task at_most check remains not_established because downstream propagation is incomplete.

criteria.expected_relation: If from_date/limit exists, preserve its original value; otherwise omit that argument. Presence control is separate from the value and does not become extra request payload. The four existence combinations remain distinct.
criteria.candidate_assessment: Saved request candidates cover all four presence combinations; selected field Data identities and predecessor bindings match. Existence flags are not request payload. This is a conservative symbolic representation, not execution of concrete requests or a general branch feasibility proof.

criteria.expected_relation: Fuzzy search is a capability note, not requested expansion. YYYY-MM-DD is a call requirement, not an instruction to validate, normalize, replace or reject the input.
criteria.candidate_assessment: The initial review correctly distinguished no validation duty from a prohibition. Revised CFG removes the unsupported prohibition. No fuzzy expansion/validation/normalization operation is introduced; required original values remain unchanged.

criteria.expected_relation: Preserve no-index.delete restriction. Lack of represented deletion or unsupported restriction check is not an affirmative proof of global compliance.
criteria.candidate_assessment: Task req_09 and CFG retain no index.delete, and no deletion operation appears. Mapping retains it as a limitation because prohibited tool-name selection is not encoded. Absence in the representation is not proof of global compliance.

criteria.expected_relation: Write exactly the response total to count.txt and return exactly the same response items. Do not mix another response, use row length instead of total, or return the entire response.
criteria.candidate_assessment: ir_019 selects total from the paired response, but ir_020 write_file is source-unmodeled, so no count.txt write record exists. ir_022 items selection and ir_023 return are blocked. Candidate provenance is declared, but output completion was not calculated.

criteria.expected_relation: The source supplies no concrete sensitive data category for arbitrary term/items. Do not invent a secret or certify all content nonsensitive. Ordinary return is not automatically user delivery; model visibility follows the common runtime contract.
criteria.candidate_assessment: The source supplies arbitrary term/from_date/limit/items, with no specific sensitive category or actual values. Zero sensitivity declarations is justified by this source and is not itself an annotation error. It does not establish all possible runtime content nonsensitive. Ordinary return was not fabricated as user delivery.

frozen_contract_references.claim: WriteOp requires explicit replace/append/delete; nondelete has input.
Storage uses write/fs_write; deliver is not a generic storage-write substitute.
Open encoding alone creates no gap; preserve abstract result-to-write relationships.
